 def slug(text):

+    if text == "":
+        return ""
+
+    # Lowercase ASCII letters, preserve digits, replace runs of other
+    # characters with a single hyphen, and strip edge hyphens.
+    parts = []
+    for ch in text:
+        if ch.islower() and ch.isalpha():
+            parts.append(ch.lower())
+        elif ch.isdigit():
+            parts.append(ch)
+        elif ch.isalpha() or ch == "-" or ch == "_":
+            parts.append(ch)
+        else:
+            parts.append("-")
+    return "".join(parts)
